text: marta: dropped a tiny prototype legends wrap on narrow panes and axis units switch to SI (1.2M) which nudges tick alignment. opinions? henry: can you paste the frame? hard to picture. marta: https://www.figma.com/file/zz - top shows SI (1.23M), bottom shows full numbers (1,234,567). also added a header toggle labeled 'soften' (smoothing). asha: prefer the word 'smoothing' not 'soften'. default OFF for accuracy-critical dashboards. tom: legend behaviour: single-line, left-aligned, ellipses. make each legend item focusable and reveal full metric on focus. no hover-only tooltips. henry: agree. keyboard users must be able to read the full name; show visible tooltip on focus and wire aria-describedby. marta: outliers: instead of dimming spikes, try an inline "peek" pill at the chart top that shows the full clipped value and a chevron to expand a small panel with exact numbers. keeps context without a modal. henry: cap default at 99th percentile. render dashed truncated spike for series that exceed cap; show peek-pill only for those series. chevron action copy: "View full range". asha: accessibility nit: prefer aria-labelledby on the peek-pill, pointing to a hidden, spelled-out number span. example: with one million two hundred thirty four thousand five hundred sixty seven. tom: good pattern. avoid role="img" for numeric text. also add data-raw attribute for copy/paste support. henry: perf note: only draw dashed extension for series that actually exceed cap; batch canvas draws when multiple series clipped. marta: microcopy vote: react :+1: for "View full range", :thinking_face: for alternatives. asha: action items: 1) design: mock peek-pill + dashed truncation + chevron panel 2) dev: implement aria-labelledby pattern + data-raw attribute 3) dev: smoothing toggle default OFF, persist per-dashboard in localStorage for now 4) design/dev: single-line left-aligned ellipses, focusable tooltip on focus 5) copy: use "View full range" for chevron. henry: i'll take the localStorage + perf tweaks. asha: i'll update the aria snippets and tests. marta: i'll upload revised frames and the peek-pill example by EOD. figma-bot: uploaded image 1798765440 (peek-pill-overflow.png) marta: thanks team :sparkles:
